notes.title: What do you want to see next?
notes.notes: Hey, to everyone who's recently bought the game, thank you for playing. I'd love to know what you want added to the game. New levels? New features? Anything else you think the game needs?

notes.title: Semi Truck Fix
notes.notes:
Yesterday's update made it impossible for Semi Trucks to give goal points. Very big oversight on my part. Sorry about that! I've uploaded a fix last night around 1am PST which fixed that.

And this morning I uploaded a new fix for some other small bugs. Hope you're all enjoying the game. Thanks.

notes.title: Achievements Unlocked!
notes.notes:
I've just added 5 steam achievements. More are coming, but these 5 are just the first batch to test it out. Let me know if you run into any problems.

There are also 4 brand new pre-release levels you can play right now. The artwork and narration isn't finished yet. They are just gameplay only for now. But I think they're a lot of fun and I hope you enjoy.

Theres also some new secrets. :-]

notes.title: Level Variants Are Here!
notes.notes:
The first test of the brand new Level Variant system is now live. After beating a level, you can replay it by choosing any of the available Level Variants. Currently only some levels have variants. I can't wait to get your feedback and add even more in the future.

As always, you can let me know what you think on the forums.
Talk to you again soon with more updates.

notes.title: What's Next
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42707614/4d31172c8e90119d4fffbe825c05da885446ab0b.png[/img]

[h1]What I'm Working On[/h1]

Hey guys, thanks so much to everyone who's played the game so far. I'm very excited to see so many people enjoying it. If you have any feedback, you can share it on the steam forums.

Right now I am preparing for a big update for the Steam Winter Sale. I hope to include many new levels, level variants, and a cooperative game mode. I will be rolling each of these out as I finish them over the new few weeks.

[h3]Level Variants[/h3]
First will come the Level Variants. When you beat a level, it will unlock variations of the level you just completed, allowing you to go back and replay the same level terrain with a new challenge. Variants will include different car setups and different obstacles in the road. I think this will be a really fun way to reexperience the same levels again with a new perspective, and hone your Engineering skills.

[h3]New Levels[/h3]
I'm also working on entirely new levels, which will also come with their own level variants as well. I know that there is much more ground to explore with what's possible, and I hope to make lots of new and crazy levels for you to play. I will be rolling these levels out in batches of 5 or so as I finish them, so that you all can play them and give me feedback.

[h3]Cooperative Mode[/h3]
Coop has been planned for a long time now, and I'm really excited to see people playing levels together with their friends, locally and over Steam Remote Play. But for me to add the coop mode will require a lot of overhaul of the currently very janky and simple input system. I will need to make some major changes to the games control scheme and that will probably take me a while and come with many bugs. So the cooperative mode will be coming out later than the rest, and I may first test it out in a steam Beta for anyone who wants to try out the experimental versions.

Thanks again to everyone who's played the game. It makes me so happy to finally have this on Steam and to see so many people enjoying it. If any of you would like to leave a review on the store page, that helps me out so much and I would greatly appreciate it.

See you again soon with some more updates!
-Phil.
